content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To become more than friends with another friend if you are bisexual, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Suggest a specific one-on-one weekend activity (10 minutes)
Step 2. Research local LGBTQ-friendly bars or cafes (1 hour)
Step 3. Open up about past dating experiences (45 minutes)
Step 4. Confirm the time and place for the meetup (5 minutes)
Step 5. Buy a small, thoughtful gift based on a shared joke (30 minutes)
Step 6. Select an outfit that makes you feel confident (20 minutes)
Step 7. Share a playlist of songs that remind you of them (15 minutes)
Step 8. Write down your feelings in a private journal to clarify intent (1 hour)
Step 9. Give them a genuine, deep compliment (2 minutes)
Step 10. Discuss your views on modern relationships (1 hour)
Step 11. Have a serious conversation about your bisexuality (1 hour)
Step 12. Spend a casual afternoon hanging out in a group (4 hours)
Step 13. Send a "thinking of you" text (1 minute)
Step 14. Invite them to a movie night at your place (10 minutes)
Step 15. Initiate more frequent physical contact, like hugs (5 seconds)
Step 16. Ask about their ideal partner (30 minutes)
Step 17. Reflect on the qualities you value in them (2 hours)
Step 18. Meditate to manage anxiety about rejection (20 minutes)
Step 19. Express that you value their presence in your life (5 minutes)
Step 20. Double-check your schedule for the upcoming week (10 minutes)
Step 21. Suggest watching a romantic comedy together (2 hours)
Step 22. Gauge their reaction to subtle flirting (1 day)
Step 23. Ask if they have ever thought about you romantically (15 minutes)
Step 24. Read a book on emotional intelligence and communication (3 days)
Step 25. Update your social media profile to reflect your openness (15 minutes)
Step 26. Practice what you want to say in the mirror (30 minutes)
Step 27. Look up the menu for the chosen date spot (10 minutes)
Step 28. Notice if they mirror your body language (2 hours)
Step 29. Make a reservation for two (5 minutes)
Step 30. Ask mutual friends if the person is currently looking to date (30 minutes)
Step 31. Buy a new fragrance or cologne (1 hour)
Step 32. Save up extra money for a nice outing (2 weeks)
Step 33. Tell them you’ve developed feelings for them (10 minutes)
Step 34. Do a deep-clean of your living room (2 hours)
Step 35. Ask them about their boundaries in friendships (45 minutes)
Step 36. Iron your favorite shirt (10 minutes)
Step 37. Send a text asking to talk about "us" (2 minutes)
Step 38. Listen to a podcast about queer dating (1 hour)
Step 39. Plan a "soft launch" date like a picnic (3 hours)
Step 40. Call the venue to verify their hours (5 minutes)
Step 41. Write a heartfelt letter you may or may not send (2 hours)
Step 42. Get a fresh haircut (1 hour)
Step 43. Take a long walk to clear your head (1 hour)
Step 44. Browse a flower shop for a single stem (20 minutes)
Step 45. Arrive at the designated meeting spot (15 minutes)
Step 46. Buy a nice bottle of wine or sparkling juice (20 minutes)
Step 47. Take a few days to focus on self-care (3 days)
Step 48. Check in on how they are feeling emotionally (10 minutes)
Step 49. Pack a bag with essentials for the day (15 minutes)
Step 50. Offer a sincere apology for any past misunderstandings (20 minutes)
Step 51. Set a "vibe" with a specific music playlist (10 minutes)
Step 52. Discuss your future goals and see if they align (2 hours)
Step 53. Share a secret you haven't told many people (30 minutes)
Step 54. Prepare a light snack to share (45 minutes)
Step 55. Go for a morning run to burn off nervous energy (45 minutes)
Step 56. Spend an evening reflecting on your friendship history (3 hours)
Step 57. Look them in the eyes and smile (10 seconds)
Step 58. Pick out a greeting card (10 minutes)
Step 59. Check the weather forecast for the date (2 minutes)
Step 60. Clean your car or bike (1 hour)
Step 61. Take a relaxing bath (45 minutes)
Step 62. Ask them to go for a late-night walk (1 hour)
Step 63. Buy tickets to a local museum or gallery (15 minutes)
Step 64. Review your text history for positive signs (1 hour)
Step 65. Watch a documentary about LGBTQ history together (90 minutes)
Step 66. Light some scented candles (5 minutes)
Step 67. Ask a sibling for advice on your crush (1 hour)
Step 68. Host a small dinner party where they are the guest of honor (4 hours)
Step 69. Share a childhood memory to build intimacy (20 minutes)
Step 70. Put on your favorite jewelry (5 minutes)
